officialSummary: A summary of the performance under the Citizen’s Charter of the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) during the month of September 2026 is given below – Description No. of Applications A Applications pending at the beginning of the month 3,011 B Applications received during the month 17,200 C Referred back to applicants for additional information 701 Total (A+B-C) 19,510 D Applications processed during the month – Within timeline – Beyond timeline 16,844 16,822 (99.9%) 22 (0.1%) E Applications pending at the end of the month – Within timeline – Beyond timeline 2,666 2,646 (99.2%) 20* (0.8%) * Awaiting inputs from external agencies (17), Under Process (3) Function-wise Status of Applications Received / Processed / Pending Function No. of Applications Total Processed Pending Within timeline Beyond timeline Within timeline Beyond timeline Banker to Banks and Governments 7,173 7,171 - 2 - Currency Management 7,351 6,717 14 620 - Debt Management 856 750 - 106 - Financial Markets 9 7 - 2 - FinTech 1 1 - - - Foreign Exchange Management 2,364 1,252 4 1,091 17 Payment and Settlement Systems 54 31 - 23 - Regulation and Supervision 1,702 893 4 802 3 Total 19,510 16,822 22 2,646 20 The Reserve Bank of India regularly reviews the services covered under its Citizen’s Charter and based on the recent review – (i) one service has been included under Financial Markets; (ii) eight services have been deleted under Foreign Exchange Management due to delegation of powers to Authorised Dealers; and (iii) timeline for one service under Financial Markets has been modified.
